Interface MachineError

All Known Implementing Classes:
MachineError.Generic, MachineError.InsufficientResource, MachineError.InvalidConfiguration, MachineError.InvalidDefinition, MachineError.MissingResource, MachineError.SerializationError, MachineError.TransferRejected, MachineError.WrongThread
public interface MachineError
An expected failure, returned in a Result instead of thrown (ARCHITECTURE.md §25). Exceptions are reserved for programmer errors.

The standard families are the nested records. Addons can define their own errors by implementing this interface with a code() in their namespace.
